content.text: The pH scale runs 0 to 14: strongly acidic 0-3, weakly acidic 4-6, neutral 7, weakly alkaline 8-10, strongly alkaline 11-14. Under the colours sits one idea - acids in aqueous solution are a source of hydrogen ions, H+(aq); alkalis a source of hydroxide ions, OH-(aq). Every acid reaction in this unit is those two ions meeting something.
